sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Chloe, Brian, Ursula take up arms and a day's rations (5,359 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Influencer mauled Chloe (-96 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Ursula doesn't look away. "About time someone fought back."
Ursula keeps glancing at the treeline. "Tell me you heard that too."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Nothing holds the treeline. (No lingerers to sortie against.)
Ursula came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
